health.title: Does {{name}} have any health conditions we should plan around?
health.helper: This helps us avoid foods that don't suit them. It never replaces their doctor's advice.
health.fastingRiskBanner: We'll keep fasting and big diet changes off {{name}}'s plan until you've spoken with their doctor.

medications.title: Medicines
medications.helper: We check a short list of medicines that interact with food or fasting.

screening.title: A few safety questions
screening.helper: These help us spot when a doctor should be involved first. Your answers are only used to keep plans safe.
screening.weightChange: Has {{name}}'s weight changed recently without trying?
screening.eatingConcern: Has {{name}} been worried about food, weight or eating lately?
screening.eatingSupport: We'll keep {{name}}'s plan gentle, with no weight goals or calorie talk. A doctor or eating-support service can help; you can talk to them any time.
screening.foodGroups: Is {{name}} refusing whole food groups and losing weight?
screening.gagging: Does {{name}} gag or choke on most textures?
screening.intendsToFast: Is {{name}} planning to fast, for example in Ramadan?
screening.clinicianFirst: With these medicines, fasting can cause dangerously low blood sugar. We won't plan fasts for {{name}}; please speak with their doctor before fasting.
screening.fastingSymptoms: When {{name}} fasts, do they feel faint or have very dark urine?

medicationFlags.insulin: Insulin: meals need steady carbohydrate, and fasting needs a doctor's plan.
medicationFlags.sulfonylurea: This medicine can cause low blood sugar if meals are skipped or during fasting.
medicationFlags.metformin: Usually taken with meals to settle the stomach.
medicationFlags.warfarin_vitamin_k: Keep leafy greens steady from week to week rather than cutting them out.
medicationFlags.maoi_tyramine: Aged cheese, cured meats and some fermented foods need care.
medicationFlags.levothyroxine_timing: Take on an empty stomach, away from tea, milk and iron.
medicationFlags.stimulant_appetite_suppression: Appetite may be low at midday; we'll plan a bigger breakfast and an evening snack.
medicationFlags.iron_calcium_spacing: Space iron and calcium apart, and away from tea.
